entities.summary: Ivan Chekhovich is a Russian professional ice hockey winger who is currently playing under contract with Sibir Novosibirsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was drafted by the San Jose Sharks in the seventh round of the 2017 NHL Entry Draft with the 212th pick overall.
